Title: The Nutrition Source
Description: Evidence-based guidance on food and health from the Department of Nutrition at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.
Author: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

Title: Food Politics
Description: Marion Nestle's long-running blog on food policy and food-industry marketing and how they shape nutrition research and advice.
Author: Marion Nestle

Title: Stronger by Science
Description: In-depth reviews of research on strength training and muscle growth and the nutrition that supports them.
Author: Greg Nuckols

Title: Precision Nutrition
Description: Articles on eating habits and body composition and on coaching people to change them from a nutrition coaching and certification company.
Author: Precision Nutrition

Title: NutritionFacts.org
Description: Nonprofit site founded by physician Michael Greger that summarizes nutrition studies from a whole-food plant-based perspective.
Author: Michael Greger

Title: Minimalist Baker
Description: Plant-based recipes designed to need few ingredients or one bowl or about 30 minutes.
Author: Dana Shultz

Title: Love and Lemons
Description: Vegetarian recipes built around seasonal vegetables and fruit for weeknight dinners and salads and soups.
Author: Jeanine Donofrio

Title: Smitten Kitchen
Description: Deb Perelman's home cooking blog with tested recipes for everyday meals and baking.
Author: Deb Perelman

Title: Budget Bytes
Description: Affordable recipes with per-serving cost breakdowns and meal-prep ideas.
Author: Beth Moncel

Title: Cookie and Kate
Description: Whole-foods vegetarian recipes from Kathryne Taylor, with healthy, seasonal meals made from simple ingredients.
Author: Kathryne Taylor

Title: RecipeTin Eats
Description: Nagi Maehashi's tested recipes for home cooks, from weeknight dinners to baking.
Author: Nagi Maehashi

Title: Sally's Baking Addiction
Description: Sally McKenney's baking recipes and tutorials for cakes, cookies, breads and desserts.
Author: Sally McKenney

Title: Pinch of Yum
Description: Lindsay Ostrom's food blog of simple, mostly healthy recipes for everyday dinners, soups, salads, and seasonal baking.
Author: Lindsay Ostrom

Title: Serious Eats
Description: Recipes, cooking techniques, and food science explained in depth, plus tested equipment reviews and guides to ingredients.
Author: Serious Eats

Title: The Kitchn
Description: Daily recipes, cooking tips, kitchen organization ideas, and grocery guides for home cooks.
Author: The Kitchn

Title: Bon Appétit
Description: The food magazine's site for tested recipes, cooking techniques, ingredient explainers, and restaurant and food culture coverage.
Author: Bon Appétit

Title: Once Upon a Chef
Description: Jennifer Segal's tested recipes with step-by-step photos, from weeknight dinners and soups to breads, cookies, and holiday dishes.
Author: Jennifer Segal

Title: Natasha's Kitchen
Description: Natasha Kravchuk's family food blog of tested recipes with step-by-step photos and videos, from comfort food to desserts.
Author: Natasha Kravchuk

Title: Just One Cookbook
Description: Namiko Hirasawa Chen's Japanese recipes and cooking guides, covering home-style dishes, ramen, rice, and Japanese pantry staples.
Author: Namiko Hirasawa Chen

Title: Ambitious Kitchen
Description: Monique Volz's healthy food blog of wholesome, flavorful recipes, from hearty soups and stews to gluten-free baking and snacks.
Author: Monique Volz

Title: The Mediterranean Dish
Description: Suzy Karadsheh's Mediterranean diet recipes built around vegetables, legumes, olive oil, and fish, with dishes from across the region.
Author: Suzy Karadsheh

Title: Veg Recipes of India
Description: Dassana Amit's collection of tested vegetarian Indian recipes, from regional curries and snacks to sweets, with step-by-step photos.
Author: Dassana Amit

Title: Abby Langer Nutrition
Description: Registered dietitian Abby Langer reviews diet trends and supplements and writes evidence-based articles on nutrition and healthy eating.
Author: Abby Langer
